name: ai-suite
description: Skills manager inside Claude Code: a calm Skills pane (Overview, Install, Installed, Updates, Settings, Workflows, Doctor) that opens by itself at session start, with a Settings tab for ~/.agents/config.json, a one-row band above the prompt with Open and Hide buttons, a status line entry and /skills, /skills-check, as thin layers over the ai-suite installer CLI.

repoPath.title: Repo path
repoPath.description: Your clone of the ai-suite repo (the folder holding install.sh and installer/). Leave empty to use, in order, this plugin's grandparent folder (when loaded with claude --plugin-dir from a checkout) or the marketplace clone Claude Code keeps at ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/ai-suite (after /plugin install).

python.title: Python
python.description: Python 3.9+ interpreter used to run python -m installer.

checkOnStart.title: Check on start
checkOnStart.description: When a session starts, read skill status and git updates in the background (no network) and show a summary in the status line.

openOnStart.title: Open the Skills pane at session start
openOnStart.description: Open the Skills pane when a session starts, without taking the keyboard, so the mod is visible without typing a command. On a narrow terminal the pane waits until you press Open in the band or widen the window.
